channel.title: Security Brief
channel.description: Original analysis and ranked cybersecurity news with links to original sources

item.title: The edge is where attackers get in: this week's firewall, VPN and remote-access exploits
item.description: Five exploited flaws in firewalls, VPNs, remote-support software and file-sharing servers show one pattern. The systems that sit at the edge of your network, and that administrators manage remotely, are the weakest link. Here is what to check first.

item.title: October 2026 Patch Tuesday: what the Microsoft feed shows and what to do
item.description: The Microsoft feed lists few entries, and most of them are updates to October's release rather than new fixes. The one item that needs planning is a .NET remote code execution flaw that Microsoft has not fixed yet. Identity Web and WSL need version checks if you use them.

item.title: Weekly M365 & Entra Briefing: 13 to 19 October 2026
item.description: Exchange sign-in problems after October Windows Server updates, an identity-based incident at ConnectWise that affected Microsoft 365 tenants, and why device-code abuse is still worth a Conditional Access check.

item.title: CISA Flags SonicWall SonicOS MFA Bypass Flaw Amid Reports of Possible Exploitation
item.description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added a high-severity vulnerability impacting SonicWall SonicOS to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, following reports that it said may have been exploited in real-world attacks. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-19868 (CVSS…

item.title: Hackers exploit SSHole OpenSSH flaw to breach Linux systems
item.description: Hackers are actively exploiting the "SSHole" vulnerability (CVE-2026-123158) in OpenSSH to execute commands, steal credentials, and establish persistent access.

item.title: WordPress Schwachstellen CVE-2026-119977 u. CVE-2026-100109
item.description: Es gibt derzeit wohl zwei Schwachstellen im Umfeld von WordPress, die man als Administrator kennen sollte. Einmal kann WordPress beim Core-Update in bestimmten Konstellationen angreifbar sein (CVE-2026-119977). Zudem gibt es die kritische Schwachstelle CVE-2026-100109 in Security For WooCommerce. Plugin Security ……

item.title: Hackers Exploit Patched Apple Flaw to Deliver Info-Stealing Malware, CISA Says
item.description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Wednesday added a medium-severity security flaw impacting multiple Apple operating systems to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, following reports of active exploitation. The vulnerability in question is CVE-2024-27834 (CVSS score…

item.title: Binance denies data breach after alleged ShinyHunters claims
item.description: Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange, has denied claims of a new security breach made by a threat actor using the 'ShinyHunters' handle on a newly emerged underground cybercrime forum.

item.title: Hackers Exploiting ‘SSHole’ Authentication Bypass in OpenSSH
item.description: The initial exploitation attempts are attributed to botnets and crypto miners, but other threat actors are expected to follow suit. The post Hackers Exploiting ‘SSHole’ Authentication Bypass in OpenSSH appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Critical Node-RED Flaw Exploited in Attacks
item.description: Multiple attacks from the same IP address attempted to deploy various payloads, including a Linux bot and webshells. The post Critical Node-RED Flaw Exploited in Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: N-able takes cloud platform offline after 30+ "zero-days" published
item.description: N-able has taken its hosted N-central environments offline and urged on-premises customers to shut down their servers after a security researcher publicly disclosed more than 30 alleged zero-day vulnerabilities, including exploits that could let attackers take over vulnerable systems.

item.title: FORGE Lab uses agentic tools to identify memory safety issues in Rust
item.description: Microsoft’s FORGE Lab found several memory safety issues in Rust’s standard library (std and core), including cases where code written entirely in safe Rust can trigger undefined behavior. The research used Hyenas, FORGE’s frontier research version of codename MDASH, an AI-powered vulnerability-scanning system. The…

item.title: Hackers Exploit Qubole's Trusted AWS Access to Breach Customer Accounts and Steal Data
item.description: An attacker broke into AWS accounts belonging to multiple Qubole customers between October 14 and October 26 and stole stored secrets and data, cloud security company Wiz said today. The attacker used credentials for an AWS account that Qubole's platform uses to reach those customers. How the attacker got those…

item.title: Alleged AI-aided cyberattack exploits assistant interface to breach German web host
item.description: Hackers allegedly assisted by AI breached a German web hosting company through a tool designed to allow customers to connect AI assistants to their accounts, the company disclosed.

item.title: Iris Plaza Breach May Have Exposed Data of 7.7 Million Customers
item.description: Hackers compromised an external cloud service used by the shopping platform and may have stolen personal information from it. The post Iris Plaza Breach May Have Exposed Data of 7.7 Million Customers appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: In Other News: Trezor Implant, LLMJacking Bills Hit $1M, SAP Flaws Weaponized Within Days
item.description: Noteworthy stories that might have slipped under the radar: Synology warns about NAS ransomware attacks, Flowise ‘hello’ attacks, Chainalysis breach impact expands. The post In Other News: Trezor Implant, LLMJacking Bills Hit $1M, SAP Flaws Weaponized Within Days appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.description: Ein altes Problem: Phishing-Mails von Absendern, mit denen Angreifer E-Mail-Konten von Microsoft 365 übernehmen wollen. item.title: SEGA newsletter data breach exposes 2.2 million email addresses
item.description: Japanese gaming giant SEGA has disclosed that a data breach at its third-party newsletter provider, ARARA, exposed the email addresses of 2.2 million newsletter subscribers.

item.title: CISA Announces Enhanced Reporting Form for Cyber Incidents
item.description: New questionnaire captures critical data and information that improves the agency’s ability to assess incidents, identify trends and prioritize response actions.

item.title: York University breach exposed personal information dating to 2007
item.description: York University has announced it suffered a cybersecurity incident in which a threat actor stole personal information people submitted through online forms.

item.title: Microsoft Fixes RCE Bug in Windows Paint After Weeks of Confusion
item.description: Last month, Microsoft disclosed a vulnerability in Microsoft Paint, but messaging regarding a patch was unclear.

item.title: Data breach at hearing aid giant Amplifon impacts thousands
item.description: The U.S arm of international hearing aid company Amplifon has been notifying customers about a data breach early this year that included medical information.

item.title: Black Hat India 2026 Makes a Landmark Debut in Bengaluru, Bringing the Global Cybersecurity Community to India
item.description: Inaugural edition by Informa Markets in India brings together leading researchers, security practitioners and industry decision makers for four days of cutting-edge research, technical exchange and strategic dialogue.

item.title: Vulnerability that lets hackers SSH into Linux devices is under active exploitation
item.description: Hackers are actively exploiting a recently discovered critical vulnerability that allows them to log in to privileged accounts on many Linux systems, multiple researchers are reporting. The vulnerability, tracked under the name *sshole, arises from the interaction between OpenSSH and a code library known as musl…

item.title: Hackers Compromise Ethersphere's bee-js and Swarm Desktop to Deliver Wallet-Stealing Malware
item.description: Attackers used the Ethersphere project's own release automation to publish malicious versions of two of its tools for the Swarm decentralized storage network: bee-js 13.3.0 and Swarm Desktop 0.56.2. Both releases download and run code built to steal the wallet key that Swarm Desktop keeps for its node, along with the…

item.title: Revolve Puts Data Breach Victim Count at 1.5 Million
item.description: Online fashion retailer Revolve has told regulators that the September cyberattack affected more than 1.5 million individuals. The post Revolve Puts Data Breach Victim Count at 1.5 Million appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: US bans MEXC crypto exchange over sanctions evasion, cybercrime links
item.description: The US Department of the Treasury has cut off the MEXC Global crypto exchange from the US financial system over sanctions evasion and links with cybercrime gangs.

item.title: Amplifon Americas Data Breach Impacts 1.3 Million
item.description: Hackers stole personal, health, and insurance information, including Social Security numbers, from the company’s internal systems. The post Amplifon Americas Data Breach Impacts 1.3 Million appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Over 3 Million People Hit by Frontline Education Data Breach
item.description: Frontline Education told Indiana regulators that its August data breach affected over 3 million school district staff and students. The post Over 3 Million People Hit by Frontline Education Data Breach appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Iris Ohyama data cloud breach exposes info of 7.7 million customers
item.description: Japanese manufacturer Iris Ohyama, the operator of the Iris Plaza shopping platform, disclosed that personal information belonging to about 7.7 million people may have been exposed after unauthorized access to a third-party cloud service the company used.

item.title: Installing the Fix for an Exploited WordPress Flaw Can Expose Some Sites One Last Time
item.description: Some WordPress sites can still be attacked while they install the fix for an actively exploited flaw, according to Umut Bayram, the Picus Security researcher who found it. The update that installs the fix still unpacks its files using the site's old, unpatched code, so an attacker who strikes at the right moment can…

item.title: CVE-2026-83844 Windows Paint Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
item.description: To comprehensively address the vulnerability identified by this CVE, Microsoft has released a new version of Paint with build version number 11.2609.401.0. Microsoft recommends installing this new version or ensuring that it was automatically updated.

item.title: DigiCert Data Breach Impacts Business Customer Information
item.description: Hackers created an account on an internal system and accessed names, email addresses, phone numbers, and business addresses. The post DigiCert Data Breach Impacts Business Customer Information appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Threat actors use agentic AI tooling to find and abuse exposed secrets
item.description: Microsoft Threat Intelligence has observed threat actors using an agentic AI offensive framework to search public GitHub repositories for exposed secrets, including credentials, application credentials, and AI inference-related API keys across multiple applications and cloud services. These threat actors can then use…

item.title: Zyxel GS1900 Patch Fails to Block Zero-Day Exploit Allowing Root Command Execution
item.description: Zyxel GS1900 network switches that received the vendor's earlier fix for an actively exploited flaw are still open to the exploit attackers used, researchers at Binarly found. The exploit lets anyone who can reach a switch's web management interface run commands on it without logging in. Zyxel has released new…

item.title: CISA flags WordPress RCE flaw as actively exploited in attacks
item.description: The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned federal agencies that attackers have started exploiting a recently patched high-severity WordPress vulnerability in the wild.

item.title: Attackers Crash Claude's 'Office Party' Flaw to Run Malicious Code on Linux
item.description: Attackers can exploit a flaw in Claude's document-processing tool by creating a temporary file that Anthropic's AI assistant can access and run on a user's machine.

item.title: Russian cloud firm Beget rebuilds from scratch after data wiper attack
item.description: A data-wiping malware attack has forced Russian cloud services provider Beget to rebuild its cloud infrastructure from scratch, the company said.

item.title: Claude Code is accidentally exposing secrets all over GitHub
item.description: Claude Code is leaking sensitive information on public GitHub instances thanks to a partial oversight in the way its settings files are handled. That's the finding of AI security researchers at Apiiro, who discovered thousands of secrets, including database passwords, API tokens, and root logins, amid Claude Code…

item.title: PwC's CISO on AI, Robots & What's Next for Security
item.description: As AI accelerates change across the enterprise, PwC's James Shira explains why security teams must rethink their approach to risk and adapt their strategies.

item.title: The Biggest Threat to Your GRC Job Isn’t AI. It’s Ignoring AI.
item.description: AI agents are taking over routine governance, risk, and compliance tasks, forcing GRC professionals to rethink the skills needed to stay relevant. Anecdotes examines three essential skills for the AI-driven GRC workplace: data literacy, agent governance, and communication.
